declarations.description:
A form generated from a JSON Schema. The schema describes the data and how it is validated; how the form looks is
decided in three layers, each optional:

- **Nothing**: one field per property, in schema order, each control picked from the property's `type`, `format`
  and `enum` (text field, number input, checkbox, select or radio group, date input, tag input…). Objects become
  groups, arrays of objects repeatable groups.
- **`ui-schema`**: a layout tree in the JSON Forms shape. `VerticalLayout`, `HorizontalLayout`, `GridLayout`
  (`options.columns`, default 2; a child takes one column unless it sets `options.span`), `Group` (`options.collapsible`), `Categorization` (tabs, or
  `options.variant: "stepper"`) and `Label` hold `Control`s, each pointing at the data with a `scope`
  (`#/properties/name`). A `rule` shows, hides, enables or disables any element from the data; `options.widget`
  picks another control. `{ "type": "Control", "scope": "*" }` stands for every field not placed elsewhere.
- **Markup**: put `c2-json-field` elements (with any HTML around them) inside the form and they replace the
  generated layout, each rendering the field its `scope` names.

A new kind of control or layout is a renderer: `registerRenderer({ name, tester, render })` for every form, or the
form's `renderers` property for one. The highest tester rank wins.

Validation runs on every change with the built-in validator (or `validator`). A field shows its error once it is
committed (`change`), or for every field after `reportValidity()` or a submit attempt. Errors of fields a rule hides
are ignored. Inside a `<form>`, the element is a form control: it submits its value as JSON under `name`, blocks
submit while invalid and resets with the form.

The value is a plain object. An emptied text field removes its key, so `required` reports it.
declarations.name: JsonForm

slots.description: `c2-json-field` elements and any markup around them. When present, they replace the generated layout.

members.name: schema
members.description: The JSON Schema of the value. A JSON string is parsed.

members.name: uiSchema
members.description: The layout: a UI schema element tree. Without it, one field per property in schema order. A JSON string is parsed.

members.name: name
members.description: Submitted as JSON under this name by an enclosing `<form>`.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables every control; the value is not submitted and does not block a form while disabled.

members.name: validator
members.description: Replaces the built-in validator, e.g. Ajv through `fromAjvErrors`.

members.name: renderers
members.description: Renderers for this form only, on top of the ones registered with `registerRenderer`.

members.name: serverRendered
members.description: A declarative shadow root is attached before the element upgrades: the form was rendered on the server.

members.name: value
members.description: The data the form edits. Defaults from the schema are filled in where the value has none.

members.name: errors
members.description: Every current validation error, except those of fields a rule hides.

members.name: checkValidity
members.description: True when the value is valid. Shows nothing.

members.name: reportValidity
members.description: Shows every field's error, focuses the first invalid field and returns true when the value is valid.

members.name: reset
members.description: Puts back the last value the application set and hides every error.

members.name: controlFor
members.description: The control showing `pointer`: in this form's shadow root, or in a `c2-json-field`'s.

events.name: input
events.description: Fired on every edit, after `value` is updated.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when an edit is committed (a text field loses focus, a checkbox toggles, an item is added).

declarations.description:
Places one field of the enclosing `c2-json-form` in your own markup. Put these, with any HTML and CSS around them,
inside the form and they replace its generated layout: the form still owns the value, validation and events, and
each field renders the control (with its label, hint and error) for the data its `scope` names.

`scope="*"` renders every field that no other `c2-json-field` of the form places, so a field added to the schema
still shows up. A scope naming an object renders the object's group.
declarations.name: JsonField

members.name: scope
members.description: The data this field edits: `#/properties/billing/properties/zip`, the shorthand `billing.zip`, or `*` for the rest.

members.name: options
members.description: The control's UI schema options, e.g. `{"widget": "textarea"}`. A JSON string is parsed.

members.name: connectForm
members.description: Markup can upgrade the fields before their form: wait for the form's definition.
